title: First Day Where You Have Been in All the Rooms
goal: Find the first day every room has been visited.
strategy: The first arrival at a new room is on an odd visit, forcing a return to its prescribed earlier room. Replaying the known segment and then moving forward gives a recurrence for first-visit days.
